Subject: Embeddings pricing + dimension support questions

Hi Marcus,

Quick one from our side as we evaluate Redwood for document search: can you send a baseline rate card for hosted embeddings (per-vector and per-token options)? A few specifics we care about:

- Do you offer a per-vector unit price (we prefer fixed per-vector) and/or a per-1k-token alternative?
- Which embedding models are currently supported on the hosted API and which output sizes/dimensions (e.g., 512 / 1024 / 1536)?
- Any volume tiers / committed discounts for ~400k vectors/month now and expected ramp to ~2M vectors/month in Q3?
- Are there any restrictions on vector dimensionality for similarity search features (e.g., is 1536 fully supported for cosine/ann workflows)?

I attached a quick export of our last 30 days for context (small sample). Ideally we’d get a short option list we can run vs our internal cost model.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if that’s easier.

— Alex
Alex Grewal
Head of Product
NimbleSearch
alex@nimblesearch.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing + dimension support questions

Alex — thanks for the clear context and the usage sample. Short answers up front, then a couple of concrete pricing options attached.

Baseline availability:
- Per-vector: yes — common for similarity workloads.
- Per-1k-token: also supported for text->embedding flows where tokenization matters (usually for truncated or multi-chunk flows).
- Models/dimensions: redwood-embed-2-small (512d), redwood-embed-2 (1536d), and a compatibility legacy option (open-embed-1024) are all available on hosted. 1536 is fully supported for cosine and ANN pipelines.

Attached: redwood_emb_ratecard_v1.pdf (provisional rates) + a CSV template to capture expected monthly distribution across dimensions.

Two starter pricing options (provisional, subject to contract):
1) Self-serve (no commit) — baseline
   - Per-vector: $0.0015 / vector
   - Per-1k-tokens: $0.0020 / 1k tokens (for tokenized flows)
2) Committed-volume (12-mo) — tiered discounts
   - 0–500k vectors/mo: $0.0010 / vector
   - 500k–1.5M vectors/mo: $0.00085 / vector
   - 1.5M+ vectors/mo: $0.00070 / vector

Notes: commits are monthly averaged; we can also do a blended per-token alternative if your ingestion is token-heavy. The attached PDF spells this out and includes examples for 512 vs 1536 dimension storage and estimated tokenization overhead.

If you want, I can schedule a 30-min call with Tessa (our sales ops) to walk through usage profiling and propose an MOU with exact blended rates for your expected ramp.

Best,
Marcus

Tessa / Neha — forwarding Alex’s note. NimbleSearch is a mid-stage search vendor; current sample indicates ~400k vectors/mo but they expect a 5x ramp to ~2M in Q3 if they go live. Quick thoughts / ask:

- Proposal: offer a 12-month commit with the following candidate pricing (aggressive enough to win while preserving margin):
   * 0–500k: $0.00095 / vector
   * 500k–1.5M: $0.00080 / vector
   * 1.5M+: $0.00065 / vector
- Keep per-1k-token option for non-vectorized preproc flows; no discount on token unit rates for now.
- Confirm that 1536-dim embeddings are allowed on hosted endpoints (I noted they want cosine and ANN workflows) — engineering already confirmed support but we should add a short bullet in the quote about recommended index memory overhead.
- Can finance approve a 6-week trial credit $5k and apply it to first invoice for a committed deal?

Also, if we give them a custom SLA or 99.9% availability, require a minimum 6-month commit. Thoughts on legal redlines (standard MSA + SOW)?

Marcus
